claims.text: Applicants must be employed by or formally affiliated with a UK-based organisation.
Applicants from racially minoritised communities are explicitly encouraged.
Partnership applications between researchers and racially minoritised communities are explicitly encouraged.
The endowment is restricted to work relating to the Commonwealth and the UK's colonial-migration history.
The research should contribute to understanding, public debate, policy and/or practice on tackling racial inequalities, discrimination and disadvantage.
The research should map pathways towards a UK that is comfortable with and reaping the benefits of its growing racial diversity.

records.opportunity_id: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
records.justification: All claims made in the agent's text regarding eligibility criteria are directly supported by the provided page text, which lists both what will be funded and what will not be funded.

claims.text: Proposals must address one or more of the priority questions.
Proposals must have a clear path to impact.
Proposals must have a clear conceptual framework.
Proposals must have appropriate and rigorous methodology.
Proposals must be led by an experienced team.
Proposals must offer good value for money.
Individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the institution hosting the grant are not eligible.
Projects led by individuals unaffiliated to any particular organisation are not eligible.
Projects led by schools or further education colleges are not eligible.
Projects led by undergraduates or master’s students are not eligible.
PhD fees or projects where the main purpose is to support a PhD are not eligible.
The establishment of academic posts is not eligible.
Ongoing costs or the costs of ‘rolling out’ existing work or services are not eligible unless explicitly agreed with the Foundation in advance.
‘Dissemination-only’ projects are not eligible.
Local charities are not eligible.
Replacement for statutory funding is not eligible.
Local social services or social welfare provision are not eligible.
Requests for financial help or educational fees from or on behalf of individuals are not eligible.
Projects led by organisations or institutions that are not based in the UK are not eligible.

records.justification: The agent's text accurately reflects the eligibility criteria mentioned in the page text, specifically regarding the encouragement of diverse applicants, those from racially minoritized communities, and partnership applications involving these communities.

claims.text: Applicants from diverse backgrounds are encouraged.
Applicants from individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities are particularly encouraged.
Partnership applications which bring together researchers and racially minoritised communities to explore challenges and develop solutions are strongly encouraged.
